answer: A newcomer spinning up many keys faces a rising cost, since every identity needs independent vouching and locked capital. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded identity trellis: each agent must stake tokens and accumulate peer attestations over successive epochs before gaining weight. Fake personas can be fabricated like a fable, but they cannot cross the economic horizon where stake plus reputation outpaces the cost of forgery, making mass identity creation unprofitable. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
